prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a polished landscape Chinese software migration change-summary infographic. Use clear, sharply rendered large Chinese typography, a neutral pale background, restrained blue accents, and amber only for remaining differences. Use categorical number cards, NOT progress bars, quantitative bars, pie charts or area encodings. No logos or mascots. Equal-sized cards are labels only. No overall completion percentage.

Exact title: "Go 迁移｜Provider 请求 Authority 对齐"
Subtitle: "主机大小写 · 数字端口 · HTTP / HTTPS 默认端口"

Three peer panels with exact text:
Panel A heading "32 个请求对象断言"
Before label "修复前：22 / 32 匹配"
After label "修复后：32 / 32 匹配"
Small detail "direct / SSE · ASCII / IPv6"

Panel B heading "12 个真实 HTTP 断言"
Before label "修复前：8 / 12 匹配"
After label "修复后：12 / 12 匹配"
Small detail "Host · 请求目标 · TCP dial · API key"

Panel C heading "36 个双方完成的诊断观察"
Before label "差异：14 → 4"
Small detail "剩余：Unicode 主机、空 fragment 的请求对象表示"

Below the panels put a clean left-to-right workflow:
"实际 Python provider + SDK" → "真实 HTTP 编码" → "仅 TCP 目的地改为自有 loopback" → "Go wire 对照"

A concise invariants row, exact labels:
"配置审计标识保留"
"IPv6 字面量保留"
"认证与重定向守卫保留"
"未新增依赖"

A validation / open-scope footer with these exact texts:
"通过：provider 用例、vet、类型审计、19 项扫描守卫"
"仍开放：全量 Go reload 时序、IDNA 请求对象与 URL 接受范围"
"证据边界：12 个 HTTP wire 用例不证明完整 IDNA 或 TLS / SNI 等价"
Date: "2026-10-11"

Constraints: all counts above are exact. Do not claim migration complete or all full-suite gates green. Keep the text concise, legible and spacious. Avoid proportional marks entirely.
mode: built-in generation followed by built-in edit
edit_prompt:
Edit this infographic only to reflect expanded Unicode coverage and unresolved failures. Preserve the overall landscape layout, typography, palette, workflow, other counts and invariants. Use numeric cards, never proportional bars.

Change title to "Go 迁移｜Provider 请求主机与端口对齐".
Change panel B heading from "12 个真实 HTTP 断言" to "14 个真实 HTTP 断言".
Change its before number to "修复前：8 / 14 匹配".
Change its after number to "修复后：12 / 14 匹配" and use amber, not a green success cue.
Replace its small detail with two lines:
"Host · 请求目标 · TCP dial · API key"
"仍失败：dotted-I 主机的 2 个 wire 断言".
Keep panel A 22/32→32/32 and panel C 14→4 exactly.
In the workflow, put "仅 TCP 目的地改为自有 loopback" before "真实 HTTP 编码" so the workflow is provider+SDK → TCP destination rewrite → real HTTP encoding → Go wire comparison.
Change bottom success text to "通过：32 个请求断言、vet、类型审计、19 项扫描守卫".
Change open text to "仍开放：2 个 Unicode wire 差异、IDNA 对齐、Go reload 时序".
Change evidence boundary text to "证据边界：14 个 wire 用例，12 个匹配；不证明完整 IDNA 或 TLS / SNI 等价".
Keep date and "未新增依赖". Do not claim the whole provider package, full Go suite, or migration passed. All text must be sharp and verbatim.
